statement.p: At a pizza parlor, the lunch special comes with your choice of a pizza slice, a salad and a drink. There are \displaystyle{8} pizza slice options, \displaystyle{6} salad options, and \displaystyle{7} soda options.
(a) How many different ways are there to choose a lunch special combination?

(b) Lola likes 3 of the pizza options, 1 of the salad options, and 4 of the drink options. If Lola randomly selects a lunch special, what is the probability that it will be a combination where she likes all three choices?
Preview Question 1 Part 2 of 2 Give the probability as a fraction or as a decimal rounded to four decimal places.
